context_guard.rule: true token count comes from a num_predict=1 preflight at the production num_ctx; a row is INPUT_CONTEXT_TRUNCATION iff true_tokens exceed the limit or the production call reports a different prompt_eval_count. Character heuristics are never scientific truth: measured chars/token on these prompts spans 2.74 to 7.43, and V4's chars/2.0 rule voided 30 rows that in fact used about a quarter of the window.

promotion_rule.covariate_reported: mean rendered prompt tokens per candidate; length is a Pareto axis, not a defect
promotion_rule.paired_test: one-sided exact sign test on discordant positive outcomes
promotion_rule.paired_unit: positive probe on the common in-budget set

qualification_rule.explicit_positive_meaning: the decisive relation is asserted outright in the state
qualification_rule.frontier_selection: among levels 1..3 minimise |accuracy - 0.625|, ties to the lower level
qualification_rule.selection_source: DEV only; permanent JSON/typed-AST control only; no candidate outcome
